name: daniil-mods
description: Copies of Claude Code mods and skins collected from other authors, to install from one place and adapt later.

plugins.name: readable-layout
plugins.description: Your messages and Claude's answers in labeled bordered boxes, short notes as dim lines, a rule at the end of each turn.

plugins.name: mermaid-inline
plugins.description: Mermaid diagrams drawn as box art inline in the transcript.

plugins.name: ui-themes
plugins.description: Prompt and reply on coloured padded backgrounds, themed markdown, matching status line, /ui-theme picker.

plugins.name: agent-monitor
plugins.description: Plan progress bar above the prompt and a pane with every subagent: model, context, estimated cost, time.

plugins.name: prompt-queue
plugins.description: /q <text> holds a prompt while Claude works and sends it when the turn ends.

plugins.name: codevibez
plugins.description: Plain English in place of raw tool rows, a summary line at the end of each turn, /codevibez to switch back.

plugins.name: cc-notebook
plugins.description: Answers drawn as pictures with Typst: LaTeX math, diagrams, plots and charts in the chat; also Python notebooks. Needs a kitty-graphics terminal.

plugins.name: firelight
plugins.description: Firelight themes for /theme: Coal, Smoulder and Ash; recolours the terminal while selected.
